isobutyrylmalonyl (BB0098) is this rule plus fabH (KSIII), so every isobutyrylmalonyl cluster also satisfies BB0084: all 7 BB0098 hits in MIBiG 4.0 were also BB0084 hits with no extra gene credited. Keeps the 17 genuine ethylmalonyl-only hits.

methoxybenzoxazolinate (BB0041) is this rule plus p450 and the O-methyltransferase, so it always satisfies BB0128 too: 3 of 3 overlaps in MIBiG 4.0 credited no extra gene. Keeps the 3 unmethoxylated hits.

BB0097 is this single-term rule plus four more, so BB0124 (Tyr_2_3_mutase alone) can never fire alone where BB0097 fires: 2 of 2 overlaps credited no extra gene. Keeps the 5 plain S-beta-tyrosine hits.
beta-hydroxyenduracididine (BB0121) is this rule plus GntD_guanitoxin, so it always satisfies BB0055: the 1 overlap in MIBiG 4.0 credited no extra gene. Keeps the 1 plain enduracididine hit.

BB0020 (methoxymalonyl) is this rule plus Methyltransf_3 (the O-methyltransferase fkbG/asm17), so every methoxymalonyl cluster also satisfies BB0091: all 20 BB0020 hits in MIBiG 4.0 credited the same 4 genes with no extra. Biologically sound -- hydroxymalonyl-ACP is the on-pathway precursor that the MT converts to methoxymalonyl-ACP, so where the MT is present the extender really is methoxymalonyl. Keeps the 15 BB0091-only hits. NOTE: discards BB0091 on 4 BB0020 reference BGCs (concanamycin, macbecin, FR-900520, ansamitocin) -- intended, those are methoxymalonyl clusters, not hydroxymalonyl ones.
